axes_units: Life expectancy at birth (years) on the vertical axis, ranging from 20 to 90 years; Years on the horizontal axis (1950, 2000, 2019, 2020, 2048)
summary: The figure shows life expectancy at birth across WHO regions and globally from 1950 to projected values in 2048. All regions show an increasing trend in life expectancy over time, with some fluctuations around 2020. The European and Western Pacific regions have the highest life expectancy values, projected to exceed 82 years by 2048. The African Region has the lowest life expectancy but shows significant improvement from 37.6 years in 1950 to a projected 67.0 years in 2048.
